decisions.reason: Having survived an additional review and being a clearly presented product line tightly linked to the firm's core geospatial integration business, it likely meets aspiration levels and remains worth supporting.

The open GIS development framework fits the firm's platform-oriented strategy and custom solution capabilities, so boundedly rational management would continue it unless performance clearly deteriorates.

This GIS-focused identity service is close to the established offer and supports enterprise integration needs, but its somewhat narrower positioning makes it slightly more vulnerable if results fall short of aspirations.
As a new consulting workshop that builds directly on the firm's established advisory and training strengths, it is inexpensive to carry and likely retained while management learns about demand.
